Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Rajesh Kumar Gupta
 On The 6 th Of January, 2026
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 53158 of 2025
 Bhagwat Singh @ Bhagwat @ Bhola Parihar
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Sunil Kumar Dubey - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Anurag Sharma - Pp for the State.
 Order

This is third application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C/483 of the BNSS for grant of bail to the applicant in connection with Crime No. 306 of 2023 registered at Police Station - Bhonti, District Shivpuri (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 457, 380, 366, 376, 376-D, 506, 342 of IPC & Sections 5G, 5L/6 of POCSO Act.

Second application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 04.04.2025 passed in M.Cr.C. No.848/2025.
2.
The allegation against the present applicant is that he along with another co-accused committed rape upon the minor prosecutrix.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.

As per prosecution story, prosecutrix got missing on 01.11.2023 and recovered on 12.01.2024 and in her statements recorded u/Ss. 161 & 164 of Cr.P.C. on 12.01.2024, she has not made allegation applicant/accused but later on 14.01.2024, she made allegations against the applicant and co-accused Pawan.

The another co-accused namely- Pawan has already been enlarged on bail by the co-ordinate Bench of this court vide order dated 17.9.2024 passed in NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-GWL:395 2 MCRC-53158-2025 M.Cr.C. No.28873/2024 on the similar set of facts and circumstances, therefore, applicant seeks parity also.
The applicant is custody since 11.02.2024.
After conclusion of investigation, charge-sheet has been filed, therefore further custodial interrogation is no more required.
The applicant is permanent resident of District Shivpuri (M.P.) and there is no possibility of his absconding or tempering with prosecution case.
On these grounds, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, on the ground of parity and also looking to the period of custody, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court.
